children.text: VirtualList provides a scrollable container, which renders only a visible part of a list of components. It automatically measures the height of items to detect the position of the visible portion and adjusts scroll values and container height.
Internally, we use this component in
to display arbitrary sized lists of
As the height of an item is unknown until it's rendered, the items which are not yet rendered are estimated to have an average height of the rendered items.
detects, that there's enough space for more items.

Avoid using marginTop/marginBottom on row content because of margin collapsing—row height calculation can become inaccurate. Prefer wrapping each row in a container and using padding, or use CSS gap with flex or grid for row spacing. When using gap, pass the same value in virtualRowInfo.gap so the list can account for it in scroll and row position calculations.
